app.name: AutoLab
app.tagline: Research with sources you can check.

empty.mine: No workspaces yet. Create the first one.

workspace.name: Name
workspace.archivedNote: This workspace is archived. It is read-only.
workspace.notFound: This workspace does not exist, or you have no access to it.

workspaceActions.archiveText: The workspace becomes read-only and all members are removed. You can unarchive it later.
workspaceActions.archivePublicText: The workspace becomes read-only, all members are removed, and you stop being the owner. Anyone can then take it.
workspaceActions.unarchiveText: You can work in it again. Members do not come back; add them again.
workspaceActions.makePublicText: Everyone can see its name, description and accepted works. This cannot be undone.
workspaceActions.takeText: You become the owner and the workspace becomes active again. It stays public.
workspaceActions.leaveText: You lose all your roles here. The owner can add you again.
workspaceActions.deleteText: Only a workspace without tasks can be deleted. Its files are deleted too. This cannot be undone.

members.title: Members
members.removeText: They lose all their roles in this workspace. You can add them again later.

files.title: Files
files.removeText: The file is deleted from the server. This cannot be undone.

task.inputHint: What should the model research or write? Plain words are best.
task.noPipelines: No pipeline is ready yet. The worker adds them when it starts.
task.noModels: No model is available. An admin can add one.
task.draftNote: This is a draft. Nothing runs until you queue it.
task.failedNote: The task failed. The steps show where it stopped.
task.noPlan: The pipeline file cannot be read, so the steps are unknown.
task.notFound: This task does not exist, or you have no access to it.

taskActions.cancelText: The worker stops before its next step. A cancelled task cannot be started again.
taskActions.deleteText: The steps, model calls, reviews and the work are deleted too. This cannot be undone.

errors.network: The server cannot be reached. Try again in a moment.
errors.validation_error: Some fields are not filled in correctly.
errors.workspace_not_found: This workspace does not exist, or you have no access to it.
errors.workspace_not_empty: Only an empty workspace can be deleted. Archive it instead.
errors.workspace_not_free: Someone else has already taken this workspace.
errors.workspace_archived: This workspace is archived. It is read-only.
errors.user_not_found: There is no user with this username or email.
errors.already_member: This person is already a member.
errors.already_owner: This is the owner. The owner is not added as a member.
errors.file_not_found: This file does not exist any more.
errors.task_not_found: This task does not exist, or you have no access to it.
errors.task_not_draft: Only a draft can be changed or queued.
errors.task_not_cancellable: This task cannot be cancelled now.
errors.task_running: The task is running. Cancel it first.
errors.task_published: The work of this task is published. Remove the publication first.
errors.model_unavailable: This model is not available now.
errors.reviewer_not_member: The reviewer must be in this workspace.
errors.log_not_found: The full log of this call is not kept any more.
errors.call_not_found: This model call does not exist.
